method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 1 December 2025 (amendments to Act 31 of 2023 shown); with the Employment of Foreign Manpower (Work Passes) Regulations 2012 (S 569/2012), informal consolidation in force from 1 January 2026, regs 2(3), 17, 18 and the Seventh Schedule only
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the foreign employee: s 2 (foreigner, foreign employee, self-employed foreigner), s 12 with reg 2(3) (validity of the work pass), ss 5(2), 5(7), 10 (working without a valid pass), ss 13, 14, 22 (pass offences and punishments), s 21(1), (4) (arrest without warrant, 48 hours), ss 22A, 23A, 25(4), 25(6) with regs 17, 18 and the Seventh Schedule (what the employer may take from me; duplicate pass fees of $65.40 and $109), s 9(1), (5) (termination on suspension or revocation), s 11(1), (2), (5) (the levy), ss 5(1), (3)-(6), (8), 6, 6A, 9(3), 22A(2), 22B, 25(1)-(4), 25A (what the person who employs me risks), ss 25(2), 25A, 25C(4)(c), 25G (the Controller's financial penalties on me and my appeal), s 27 (composition)
seat: the foreign employee (a foreigner who works, or seeks or is offered work, in Singapore for an employer; for ss 10 and 11, the foreigner who works on his or her own account)
